title: Hot Wheels - Epic Show
summary: The Hot Wheels - Epic Show is a Hot Wheels-themed stunt show performed at Brazilian theme park Beto Carrero World, in Penha, Santa Catarina. It features approximately 40 minutes of incredible stunts that mimic those performed by children in toy cars. The show is included in the park's entry pass.

title: Joel Rubenstein
summary: Joel Kopel Rubenstein (1936 – 1 February 2004) was an American marketing and business executive who worked with Mattel from the 1970s to 1979. Born in Baltimore, Rubenstein came to Los Angeles in 1960 to become a news reporter but ultimately led him to pursue a career in public relations, joining Mattel to become Director of Marketing and later Director of Legal....

title: Gerry Lambert
summary: Gerard Leo Lambert is a former Mattel employee who worked at Mattel from 1966 to the early 2000s. He is noted as being an engineer and playset designer, designing some of Hot Wheels's earliest playsets and simpler playsets in his later career. Prior to working at Mattel he was a tool and die maker; he is currently retired.

title: Gil Gerstein
summary: Edward Gilbert Gerstein is an American businessman and former designer who worked with Mattel from 1997 to 2000. Specializing in graphic design, he worked on various mainline models as well as other series. Prior to working at Mattel he was a website designer.
